daily_focus_title_zh: 第 37 天：问题诊断与靶向解决方案段：拒绝“政府应该立法”万金油（Targeted Problem-Solution） × 因果机制链 vs. 表面相关性切分（Causality vs. Correlation） × IELTS_Task1_Dynamic 全篇梳理

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 六级（CET-6）/ 雅思大作文（Task 2）/ 托福独立写作：深度论证与让步反驳（BP33–BP40）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 问题诊断与靶向解决方案段：拒绝“政府应该立法”万金油（Targeted Problem-Solution）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写 Problem-Solution 类作文的解决方案段：针对前文诊断出的两个具体根源，提出两项可操作、有明确执行主体和传导机制的靶向对策，拒绝只喊 'The government should make laws and raise awareness'。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / 政策与工程治理方案段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [对策总起句 Targeted Solution Thesis]：Mitigating [Problem X] effectively requires coordinated intervention across both [Level A: Technical/Curriculum Design] and [Level B: Institutional Governance].

S2 [对策 1：操作层可验证改革 Actionable Measure 1]：First, [Specific Actor 1, e.g., university departments] should replace [Vulnerable Practice] with [Verifiable Mechanism, e.g., oral defense and in-class iterative drafting], ensuring that [Specific Effect 1].

S3 [对策 2：制度/标准层激励对齐 Actionable Measure 2]：Concurrently, [Specific Actor 2, e.g., regulatory agencies / industry consortia] must establish [Concrete Standard, e.g., mandatory provenance watermarking and audit logs] to penalize [Misconduct].
S4 [协同闭环效果 Combined Outcome]：Together, aligning pedagogical verification with technical traceability curbs misuse without stifling legitimate innovation.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Dual-Level Intervention -> Actor 1 + Concrete Mechanism -> Actor 2 + Concrete Standard -> Balanced Closure. 绑定逻辑规则：L002, L010.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: To solve this problem, first, the government should pass strict laws to punish bad people. Second, schools and media should educate the public and raise their awareness. Only in this way can we build a harmonious society.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 典型的中式六级万金油套话（pass strict laws, raise awareness, Only in this way can we...），放之四海而皆空，考官已产生严重审美疲劳。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Curbing the proliferation of fabricated academic data requires coordinated reforms across both peer-review protocols and institutional promotion criteria. First, journal editorial boards should mandate that empirical submissions include executable code containers and raw sensor logs, enabling automated reproducibility checks before external review. Concurrently, university tenure committees must shift evaluation weight from raw publication counts toward verified open-source contributions and replication studies. Aligning technical verification with career incentives removes the underlying pressure to fabricate incremental results.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: AI/CS 小论文：Abstract 与 Introduction 立意与破题（BP01–BP08）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 确立研究背景与真实工程价值（拒绝空喊口号）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想作为 Introduction 第一段：说明多变量时间序列预测或具身智能控制在实际工业系统中的关键作用，以及高可靠性的刚需。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 论文 Introduction 首段，或开题报告背景首段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [任务锚定 Topic Anchor]：直接用紧凑主谓宾点明研究对象及其在真实系统中的核心功能（≤16词，禁用 In the era of AI）。
S2 [应用场景展开 Concrete Scenarios]：列举 2–3 个具体工程场景（如电网负荷调度、灵巧机械手装配）及其决策依赖。
S3 [苛刻工况约束 Operational Bottleneck]：指出真实部署环境下不可避免的物理/统计挑战（如非平稳漂移、传感器缺失、毫秒级延迟约束）。
S4 [研究必要性收束 Imperative Hook]：点明若无法克服上述约束会造成什么具体系统后果，自然引出下一段对现有方法的审视。
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Given-to-New 链：Core Task (S1) -> Practical Deployment (S2) -> Real-world Disturbances (S3) -> Consequence of Failure (S4). 绑定逻辑规则：L001, L011, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: In the rapidly developing modern world, time series forecasting plays a pivotal role in many fields. The fact that industrial sensors often have noise and distribution changes makes forecasting very hard and bad for decision making.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: ① 首句 AI 套话（In the rapidly developing... plays a pivotal role）；② 第二句严重头重脚轻（The fact that... 11词从句作主语）且用词口语化（very hard and bad）。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Multivariate time series forecasting underpins safety-critical scheduling across smart power grids, cloud clusters, and automated manufacturing. In these operational settings, control systems rely on multi-horizon predictions to balance supply fluctuations and prevent cascading overload. However, field sensors routinely operate under abrupt regime shifts, irregular sampling intervals, and high-frequency measurement noise. Failing to accommodate such non-stationary disturbances degrades long-range forecast reliability and triggers costly control oscillations.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 六级（CET-6）/ 雅思大作文（Task 2）/ 托福独立写作：深度论证与让步反驳（BP33–BP40）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 利弊权衡段：证明结构性长期收益远超短期可管可控成本（Outweigh / Trade-off Analysis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想回应 'Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?' 题型：把弊端定性为“暂时的、可通过技术/规则收敛的局部成本”，把优势定性为“不可替代的结构性长期突破”。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: IELTS Task 2 (Advantages vs. Disadvantages) / 论文设计权衡（Trade-off）段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [权衡定性主题句 Asymmetry Thesis]：Weighing both dimensions reveals that the long-term structural benefits of [X] far outweigh its manageable transitional costs.

S2 [将弊端限定为可收敛成本 Bounding the Drawback]：While [Drawback A, e.g., initial capital outlay / training overhead] poses a tangible hurdle, this cost is bounded and diminishes rapidly as [Mitigating Factor, e.g., hardware amortization / open-source standardization] matures.

S3 [凸显优势的不可替代性 Highlighting Irreversible Gain]：By contrast, the core advantage—[Benefit B, e.g., eliminating human exposure to hazardous environments / discovering non-linear scientific laws]—delivers compounding value that manual methods cannot replicate at any cost.
S4 [权衡结论 Trade-off Verdict]：Therefore, addressing the friction through targeted safeguards is far more rational than forgoing the transformative gain.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Asymmetry Thesis -> Bound the Drawback (Temporary & Mitigable) -> Highlight Compounding Advantage (Irreplaceable) -> Rational Verdict. 绑定逻辑规则：L008, L023.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Every coin has two sides. Although open-source AI has some security risks, it also has many advantages like helping researchers and small companies. So I think the advantages are bigger than the disadvantages.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 只把好坏两边并列摆出来，然后生硬宣布 advantages are bigger than disadvantages，缺乏“为什么A大于B”的权衡标尺（可逆成本 vs. 不可替代收益）。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Weighing both dimensions demonstrates that the structural scientific gains of open-weight foundation models far outweigh their manageable misuse risks. While公开 releasing model weights lowers the barrier for generating deceptive phishing content, such downstream abuse can be substantially contained through cryptographic provenance standards and endpoint spam filters. By contrast, open weights provide academic laboratories and resource-constrained hospitals with transparent, auditable architectures that proprietary black-box APIs cannot substitute—accelerating reproducible breakthroughs in protein folding and rare-disease diagnostics. Because the security risks are mitigable via defense-in-depth whereas the scientific transparency is irreplaceable, open research ecosystems yield a decisive net benefit.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 因果机制链 vs. 表面相关性切分（Causality vs. Correlation）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 在论文实验分析与雅思/托福议论文中，观察到 A 与 B 同时变化时，绝不能直接断言 A causes B；必须区分“直接因果（drives / induces）”、“中介传导（mediates / channels）”与“混杂相关（coincides with / correlates with）”。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Observation: A correlates with B. -> Confounder check: Rather than A directly causing B, confounding factor C drives both -> Controlled verification.
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 将伴随发生的数据现象直接写成绝对因果，或用 make / let 等口语词粗糙表达因果。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Increasing model parameters makes the robot grasp better in the real world.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: While scaling backbone parameters correlates with higher success rates in simulation, real-world grasping gains stem primarily from diverse tactile pre-training rather than parameter count alone.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 精准用 correlates with 界定表面伴随关系，再用 stem primarily from... rather than... 点明真实因果驱动力。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 图表叙事铁律：解读规律而非朗读表格（Interpret Patterns, Never Read Tables Aloud）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 读者自己会看表格数字。实验段落的任务不是把 Table 1 的每一行数字抄进正文，而是回答三个问题：① 跨数据集的整体胜率与极值在哪？② 哪类基线在什么条件下崩盘了？③ 这种差异验证了我们在引言/方法中提出的什么假设？
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: [Table Reference + Overall Dominance] -> [Contrast between Baseline Families under Hard Regime] -> [Mechanistic Explanation linking back to Method].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 把表格每一行数字机械抄进正文，只报数不提炼规律与原因。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Table 1 shows the results. On dataset A, our model gets 91%. On dataset B, our model gets 88%. Our model is the best on all datasets.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Table 1 shows that our model achieves the lowest forecasting error on 26 out of 30 benchmark settings. While point-wise Transformers degrade rapidly on volatile electricity load datasets (e.g., ECL), our multi-scale spectral mixer reduces MSE by an average of 16.4%, confirming that frequency-domain denoising stabilizes long-horizon representations.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 既有全局概览（26/30 最优），又有困难场景（波动剧烈的电力负载 ECL）下的流派对比，最后回扣方法论核心假设。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）与消融防御
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写 Problem-Solution 类作文的解决方案段：针对前文诊断出的两个具体根源，提出两项可操作、有明确执行主体和传导机制的靶向对策，拒绝只喊 'The government should make laws and raise awareness'。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: To solve this problem, first, the government should pass strict laws to punish bad people. Second, schools and media should educate the public and raise their awareness. Only in this way can we build a harmonious society.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L007 因果机制链 vs. 表面相关性切分（Causality vs. Correlation））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 典型的中式六级万金油套话（pass strict laws, raise awareness, Only in this way can we...），放之四海而皆空，考官已产生严重审美疲劳。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Curbing the proliferation of fabricated academic data requires coordinated reforms across both peer-review protocols and institutional promotion criteria. First, journal editorial boards should mandate that empirical submissions include executable code containers and raw sensor logs, enabling automated reproducibility checks before external review. Concurrently, university tenure committees must shift evaluation weight from raw publication counts toward verified open-source contributions and replication studies. Aligning technical verification with career incentives removes the underlying pressure to fabricate incremental results.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Pre-trained time series foundation models generally follow either continuous patch reconstruction or discrete vocabulary tokenization. Continuous reconstruction frameworks (e.g., PatchTST, MOMENT) pre-train encoders via masked patch regression, preserving fine-grained numerical resolution across continuous domains. Conversely, discrete tokenization approaches (e.g., Chronos) quantize scaled observations into fixed bins to leverage cross-entropy language modeling objectives. Despite their zero-shot transferability, both paradigms treat univariate channels independently during pre-training, ignoring physical cross-variable conservation laws that govern multivariate engineering systems.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Applying post-hoc gradient guidance during diffusion sampling often pushes intermediate noisy states off the data manifold, introducing unphysical high-frequency oscillations. To enforce physical boundary constraints without manifold deviation, we incorporate observation consistency directly into the conditional flow-matching velocity field. At flow time $\tau \in [0, 1]$, our network predicts a residual velocity $v_\theta(x_\tau, \tau \mid c)$ that projects the transport trajectory onto the null space of the linear constraint operator. This projection guarantees exact boundary satisfaction at terminal time $\tau=1$ while maintaining straight transport paths amenable to 4-step Euler integration.
